briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate AGI capability race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases as compute scales and regulatory pressure mounts. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world deployments while investment surges past $11B this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced agentic reasoning; xAI deployed Grok-4 claiming parity with o3; DeepSeek-V3 open weights trigger rapid forks across Chinese labs.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce 50k H100-equivalent cluster expansions; TSMC begins 2nm AI chip volume production for custom ASICs; energy constraints delay three major US data center projects.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before regulatory frameworks can be enacted?
